title: London raids one side of Asia — usually the high

hero.caption: of nights London sweeps the **Asia high** in its killzone. It leans up — the Asia low gets taken less often (40%).

chart.label: What London does to the Asia range
chart.sub: Measured over the London killzone, 02:00–05:00 ET
chart.note: London usually raids just one side, not both — and a clean reverse across the whole box is rare.

useIt: London usually raids one side of the Asia range — more often the high. It rarely takes both sides in the same window (7%), and a clean reverse across the whole box is rarer still (~4%). Lean with the side it takes, don't expect the round-trip.
disclaimer: Not advice · AI-backtested on 10y NQ, London killzone 02:00–05:00 ET · check it yourself
